rationale: The record shows a write action (exchange_delivered_order_items) was executed but there is no visible user confirmation before the order-changing action, which violates the confirm-before-write policy. While the agent appears to have attempted authentication via find_user_id_by_name_zip and get_user_details and looked up orders/products, the conversation provides no explicit confirmation from the user selecting the exact item or agreeing to any charges/refunds. The final message is only a generic closing and does not provide required final details (exchange order info, costs/refunds, shipping/return instructions). Because key policy steps are missing or not evidenced—especially the confirmation prior to making changes—the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
